poem:
TRANSCRIBER'S NOTES
1. Many contractions which would most
distinguish
Like soft threads of the far-off years
ago, such as the hearts and stains of
sin.

TRANSCRIBER'S NOTES
1. Many contractions which would most
distinguish
Like soft threads of the far-off years
ago, such as the hearts and stains of
sin.

Dat ol' mare o' mine.
But the Angel, calm and great is life,
I scorn men's curses, but I pray the
Lord God of Heaven.
From the Gulf and the peach and the
yellow
